FAQ

Before your visit

How do I book an appointment?

Use the appointment request form to choose a service and an available time, or call the clinic. Wait for the clinic to confirm your schedule.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Please ask the clinic what to bring. You can mention whether you have recent dental records or a list of current medications when you call.

How do I reschedule?

Call 0976 342 2320 or email the clinic with your current appointment and your preferred new time.

What are the clinic hours?

Clinic hours are pending confirmation. Call the clinic before visiting.

Is there parking or accessible building entry?

The clinic is on the second floor of Sunoria Plaza. Please contact the clinic for current parking, elevator, and entrance details.
